rulings.why: The page tells these changes from the row (`can`), or the judge could not tell (`unclear`), but no check of the shape readings does: moveup:2.4: can: 564-strip0.jpg system 2: the two stanza rows sit note for note under one tune. On the system's last note, where stanza 2's database line 5 opens, stanza 1's row prints a capital after a comma that only a line opening explains. On system 3's first note, where the change would open stanza 2's line, stanza 1 prints a lowercase first syllable of a word. Stanza 2's row alone would not tell (the moved word is the vocative particle and the new opener a name of God, both capitals anyway, and no metre is printed), so this ruling rests on the alignment across stanzas.
